limits: Windows kernel whole-job peak committed private memory is not RSS or total physical memory; fixture job caps are not production-wide limits.
Two samples per profile and changing object-pack reuse state do not establish a universal latency distribution or per-key causal effect.
The 64 MiB single-asset control did not reduce first-pack peak memory; warm repacks are not consistently faster.
Raw Git measurements override automatic maintenance off in both profiles and disable fixture hooks/templates/LFS; maintenance child suppression is separately covered by actual functional probes.
No automatic history rewrite, renormalization, object/ref/LFS path change, daemon-per-project or real user repository operation was introduced.
macOS/Linux resource-performance measurements and real Unity/Unreal Editor acceptance are not claimed by this Windows report.
